title: Emberveil: The Last Reliquary
player_fantasy: Protect a dying fire-reliquary by reading a hostile shrine and choosing when to awaken its guardian.
challenge: The shrine changes its safe route after each attunement; the player must observe before committing.
failure_recovery: A failed attunement returns the player to the last lit coal with reduced route certainty, never a dead-end state.
win_condition: Light three reliquaries and reach the central ember before the chamber cools.

mechanics.player_experience: risk a close reading of the shrine
mechanics.system: timed interaction with stateful danger response
mechanics.implementation: Enhanced Input action + gameplay state component + feedback event bus

mechanics.player_experience: choose a safer or richer route
mechanics.system: branching shrine nodes with resource consequence
mechanics.implementation: data-driven route asset + level encounter markers

camera.principle: keep the reliquary readable while preserving spatial threat cues

audio_language: resonant metal, dry ash, localized ember hum; no unproven stock assets

first_session_questions: Can a new player explain the attunement goal?
Does retreat feel like a choice rather than punishment?

ai_systemic_opposition.player_counterplay: observe pulse, retreat during HOSTILE, commit only during SAFE_WINDOW

vfx_requirements.shape: red heat fracture and outward ash burst

architecture_decisions.rationale: reusable tested input and movement behavior
deterministic state transitions and native tests
C++ owns state; Blueprint/UMG/Niagara author presentation
tunable pulse windows without code edits
